title: EDA Report Generator
summary: Streamlit upload flow: CSV or Excel is profiled in-session; structured warnings, executive summary, and column intelligence drive a downloadable HTML report with optional PDF. Configurable limits, sampling, and pytest-backed modules.
metaDescription: Streamlit EDA profiler: schema, missing values, duplicates, distributions, correlations, data-quality warnings, HTML/PDF export. Not a BI platform.
limitations: Interactive demo app: not warehouse-scale profiling or orchestrated ETL.
Row caps and sampling apply for large uploads; profiles reflect the sampled frame.
Optional PDF requires WeasyPrint and OS libs on the host.
Not a BI suite, catalogue, or production data-governance platform.

recruiter.pageTitle: EDA Report Generator — proof of work
recruiter.summary: End-to-end path I ship: Streamlit ingestion (CSV/.xlsx, sheet pick, UTF-8 + latin-1 CSV fallback), config-driven thresholds, profiling engine (missing, duplicates, distributions, correlations, column intelligence, datetime probe, structured warnings), Jinja HTML report plus optional PDF, and pytest coverage on load/profile/render.
recruiter.heroNote: Static project page: https://eda-report.vahdetkaratas.com — Streamlit demo: https://eda.vahdetkaratas.com (not hosted on this static domain).
recruiter.footerProjectSub: Portfolio · Streamlit demo + report modules · tests
